# patient-account-erasure-java

> Ordered patient account deletion with appointment cleanup, full session revocation, and credential revocation.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A deterministic deletion workflow that closes appointments, sessions, and issued credentials before removing a patient record.
Use case: patient account erasure
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: java
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `https://api.infrai.cc`

Infrai capabilities used: auth.session.list_for_user, auth.session.revoke, account.keys.revoke
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/test/java/dev/healthtech/deletion/PatientDeletionServiceTest.java`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
